0.sub: Remote · Seller Center – Marketplace Platform & Mobile Seller Experience (React Native / React / .NET / Azure)

Designed and built RESTful APIs in C# / ASP.NET Core Web API and Node.js within a 6+ service microservice architecture, published through Azure API Management with OAuth 2.0 / Entra ID security, OpenAPI contracts, and versioning; integrated a GenAI seller-support assistant on the Claude API.

1.sub: Remote · Enterprise Field Operations Platform (iOS, Android & Web · React Native / .NET / Azure)
bullets: Led a cross-functional team implementing the React Native front end for AEP's field operations platform (10+ microservice REST APIs, thousands of utility technicians); mentored engineers and partnered with product, QA, and other business units.

Configured and built APIs inside Azure: C# / ASP.NET Core Web API services on Azure App Service and Functions behind Azure API Management with Entra ID / JWT role-based authorization and Key Vault secrets; offline-tolerant sync for low-connectivity areas; Azure AI Services to classify field notes.

Automated Azure DevOps build and release pipelines with Docker agents, environment promotion, and test gates in two-week Scrum sprints; Dynatrace APM and Application Insights cut P1 mean time to resolution by 50%.

2.sub: Remote · Warehouse Management System (iOS & Android · React Native / .NET / Node.js)
bullets: Delivered React Native (TypeScript) iOS and Android features for Walmart's warehouse management system (500K+ daily associates), consuming .NET (ASP.NET Core Web API) and Node.js microservice REST APIs and real-time inventory events over WebSockets.

Designed and documented RESTful API contracts (OpenAPI, versioning, error handling); built Jest / React Testing Library / xUnit test infrastructure, raising coverage to 80%+ and cutting regression incidents by 35%; Azure DevOps and Jenkins pipelines.
Optimized app load time by 40% via bundle optimization, image caching, list virtualization, and request batching; Dynatrace across 3 apps cut MTTR by 50%.

Led development of HCSC Mobile 2.0, a HIPAA-compliant React Native member app for 1M+ Blue Cross Blue Shield members: digital ID cards, claims, provider search, push notifications, and secure messaging over .NET (ASP.NET Core Web API) REST services with Azure-hosted integrations.

Drove architecture, design documentation, sprint planning, and delivery across distributed teams; mentored 4 engineers in React Native, Redux Saga, and API integration; structured PR review improved velocity by 25%.
Established Jest unit testing standards (coverage 45% to 85%) with continuous delivery through Jenkins and Azure DevOps CI/CD to app-store releases.
Built React Native inventory apps used by 1,000+ associates daily across hundreds of stores; barcode scanning improved inventory accuracy by 25% and cut check-in time by 40%.
Designed a modular component system shared across 3 warehouse apps (40% less duplicate code) with real-time WebSocket sync to Walmart's SAP backend; 99.9% crash-free sessions.
Delivered curbside pickup, order management, and associate workflows for Store Assist, Walmart's FaaS platform, leading a team of 5 engineers in Agile/Scrum.
Implemented Electrode Native micro-frontends so React Native modules embed in existing native iOS/Android apps, cutting feature integration time by 60%.
Led engineering for the studio; shipped 0-to-1 React Native iOS/Android apps on Node.js and Firebase backends, managing App Store and Google Play releases end to end.

Architected a gas delivery tracking app (300+ daily deliveries, live driver location, push and SMS updates) on Node.js/Express and AWS; built a wine e-commerce app whose JWT-secured integrations drove 120% YoY sales growth.
Built the Mobile as Bee iOS/Android app in React Native with a Node.js REST backend streaming real-time IoT asset location over WebSockets; led an iOS refactor that cut crash rates by 60%.
